svg.title: SEP local fabric
svg.desc: The SEP local crossbar u_sep_local_axi_xbar joins five initiators to ten targets with 32-bit addresses and 64-bit data; initiator IDs are 3 bits and target IDs 6 bits. Inside sep_cpu the IFU, LSU and debug masters of the VeeR EL2 core each pass a local alias remap that rewrites the 768 MiB window at SEP_LOCAL_BASE_ADDR to 0x1000_0000. The IFU demux sends boot ROM addresses to the boot ROM mux, SEP SRAM addresses to the ifu_sram initiator and everything else to a DECERR slave; the LSU demux sends boot ROM addresses to the boot ROM mux and everything else to the lsu initiator; the debug master connects directly. The boot ROM mux feeds the boot ROM memory interface outside the crossbar. The secure DMA master passes TL-UL to AXI-Lite, AXI-Lite to AXI4 and 32 to 64-bit conversion and its own alias remap. The ext initiator is traffic from sep_system_peripherals. Targets: cpu_tcm, the ICCM and DCCM backdoor into the core DMA port; sram, whose burst demux u_sram_burst_demux sends INCR bursts and single-beat bursts through the SRAM memory interface to the 256 KiB SRAM macro and answers a multi-beat FIXED or WRAP burst with SLVERR from u_sram_burst_err_slv; dma_csr and sep_wdt, each downsized to 32 bits and converted to AXI-Lite and TL-UL for the secure DMA registers and the watchdog aon_timer; sep_reset_ctrl through an AXI to AXI-Lite converter; sep_crypto with its own interconnect; sep_system_peripherals, the output fabric; sep_io, downsized, converted to AXI-Lite and demultiplexed to the SPI host or DECERR; entropy_fifo through an AXI to AXI-Lite converter; and sep_external, whose demux sends the eFuse shim CSR window to the eFuse wrapper and the rest to the AXI extension port.
svg.text: via the eFuse mux in u_sep_crypto
